dossier.purpose: DeerFlow 2.x (ByteDance / 'DeerFlow Authors') is an open-source 'super agent harness' built on LangGraph/LangChain. It is a FastAPI Gateway with an embedded lead-agent runtime, sub-agents, per-thread sandboxes (local, Docker 'AIO', Kubernetes provisioner, E2B, BoxLite, Tenki, OpenSandbox), Markdown skills, an MCP client, persistent memory, scheduled tasks and IM-channel bridges. It also ships a Next.js web UI, an embedded Python client (DeerFlowClient / create_deerflow_agent) and a `deerflow` TUI/headless CLI. It is a ground-up rewrite of the v1 Deep Research framework, which stays on the main-1.x branch (README.md:12,17). In 2.x, 'research' is implemented as skills plus a system-prompt citation convention rather than a dedicated research pipeline (skills/public/deep-research/SKILL.md; backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/lead_agent/prompt.py:686-747).

claims.claim: DeerFlow ('Deep Exploration and Efficient Research Flow') is an open-source 'super agent harness' that orchestrates sub-agents, memory and sandboxes, powered by extensible skills.
2.0 is a ground-up rewrite sharing no code with v1; the original Deep Research framework is maintained on the main-1.x branch and active development moved to 2.0.

Built on LangGraph and LangChain; ships a filesystem, memory, skills, sandbox-aware execution and sub-agent planning. Core tools are web search, web fetch, web capture, file operations and bash, plus MCP servers and Python functions; built-in skills cover research, report generation, slides and more.

Model-agnostic: 'works with any LLM that implements the OpenAI-compatible API'. The README strongly recommends Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code, DeepSeek v3.2 and Kimi 2.5. CLI-backed providers reuse Codex CLI (~/.codex/auth.json) and Claude Code OAuth logins.

ACP agent entries (a Codex ACP adapter, MiniMax Code 'mcode') are invoked through the invoke_acp_agent tool in a per-thread ACP workspace, forwarding enabled MCP servers; keep auto_approve_permissions false for untrusted tasks.

With AioSandboxProvider shell execution runs inside isolated containers; with LocalSandboxProvider host bash is disabled by default because it is not a secure isolation boundary. Documented modes: local, Docker, Docker plus Kubernetes provisioner.

Docker AIO sandboxes default to open egress; sandbox.network.mode can be 'isolated' or 'allowlist' (operator domains plus interactive approval; private, loopback and cloud-metadata addresses are never approvable).
Linux plus Docker is the recommended persistent-server target; macOS and Windows are 'development or evaluation environments'; the Windows local flow needs Git Bash and WSL 'is not guaranteed'.

database.backend sqlite or postgres is shared by the LangGraph checkpointer, Store and app data. Production defaults to one Gateway worker because active runs are owned in-process; multi-worker needs Postgres, the Redis stream bridge, run-ownership heartbeats and DB run events. Lease reconciliation marks runs from dead workers as errors.
DeerFlow can be embedded as a Python library (DeerFlowClient, same response schemas as the Gateway), and `deerflow` is a TUI/headless workbench (--print, --json, --continue, --resume).
The claude-to-deerflow skill lets Claude Code send research tasks to, and manage threads on, a running DeerFlow instance (default http://localhost:2026).

Sub-agents are spawned on demand with scoped context, tools and termination conditions (default 'isolated' context, optional 'snapshot'); '/goal <condition>' attaches a thread goal with a default cap of 8 hidden continuations; scheduled tasks (once/cron/interval) run as non-interactive runs.

Observability is opt-in: LangSmith and Langfuse trace all LLM calls, agent runs and tool executions; Monocle traces capture prompts, tool arguments and responses verbatim and its remote exporters (okahu, s3, blob, gcs) send them off-box.

Security notice: designed for a local trusted environment (127.0.0.1); the Docker stack publishes on 127.0.0.1 unless BIND_HOST is set; treat Gateway admin as equivalent to code execution on the host (stdio MCP servers).

install.method: Clone plus setup wizard (prerequisite for every path)
install.command: git clone https://github.com/bytedance/deer-flow.git && cd deer-flow && make setup

install.method: Local development without Docker (needs Node 22+, pnpm, uv, nginx)
install.command: make check && make install && make dev

install.method: Harness/TUI as a Python package (publication is not evidenced by any workflow in the repo)

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes - README.md:280 names Linux plus Docker the recommended persistent-server target; CI and release builds run on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/backend-unit-tests.yml:50) and the backend/frontend/provisioner images are amd64-only (.github/workflows/nightly.yaml:10).
platforms.wsl2: unknown - README.md:382 says WSL is 'not guaranteed' for the local flow (Git Bash recommended on Windows), while scripts/check.py:156 and scripts/doctor.py:228 tell Windows users to 'use WSL for local mode or use Docker mode'; there is no WSL job in CI.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes (development/evaluation only) - README.md:280; macOS handling exists for Apple Container (config.example.yaml:1472-1476) and Claude OAuth export (README.md:252-256); the AIO image 1.11.0 is multi-arch (config.example.yaml:1485-1489). There is no macOS CI job in .github/workflows, published backend/frontend images are amd64-only (nightly.yaml:10), and Apple Container supports only network.mode open with an unhardened invocation (backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:922).
platforms.gpu: no - DeerFlow itself needs no GPU (no CUDA/GPU code outside a browser-session comment); README.md:279 says to size any self-hosted LLM separately; local model servers are reached over HTTP (vLLM/Ollama/MindIE providers, backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml:72).

integrations.cli: `deerflow` console script (deerflow = deerflow.tui.cli:main, backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml:61-62): Textual TUI, headless --print / --json one-shots, --continue, --resume THREAD, --recursion-limit N, and `deerflow extensions ...` (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/tui/cli.py:55-84,225-230; README.md:1837-1847). Project lifecycle is driven by make targets (Makefile:65-219).
integrations.mcp: MCP client only. Loads stdio/SSE/HTTP MCP servers from extensions_config.json (OAuth client_credentials/refresh_token for HTTP/SSE, stdio command allowlist npx/uvx) plus an optional durable submit/status/cancel task adapter (README.md:547-571; backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:1-15). No DeerFlow-as-MCP-server found: the only mcp import in non-test backend code is ClientSession (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/session_pool.py:51).
integrations.sdk_or_api: Python SDK: deerflow.client.DeerFlowClient (embedded, synchronous chat()/stream() generators; backend/packages/harness/deerflow/client.py:145-248; README.md:1639-1686) and create_deerflow_agent(model: BaseChatModel, tools, features=RuntimeFeatures(...), checkpointer=..., subagent_runtime=...) (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/factory.py:66-81; README.md:1385-1399). The lead_agent graph is also registered for LangGraph Server/Studio (backend/langgraph.json:8-10). HTTP: FastAPI Gateway on :8001 with LangGraph-compatible thread/run routes (POST /api/threads/{id}/runs, /runs/stream, /runs/wait, cancel, join; backend/app/gateway/routers/thread_runs.py:923-1215), exposed through nginx at /api/langgraph/*; OpenAPI at /docs is on by default (backend/app/gateway/config.py:11); cookie sessions or scoped personal access tokens dfp_... limited to thread/run routes (README.md:915-937; backend/app/gateway/auth/pat.py:22-33). Opt-in HMAC-verified GitHub webhook route /api/webhooks/github, mounted only when a secret is configured (backend/app/gateway/app.py:963-979). IM bridges (Feishu, Slack, Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, WeChat, WeCom, Buzz) use the same API (README.md:579-593).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code -> DeerFlow: the claude-to-deerflow skill drives a running Gateway with curl against /api/langgraph/threads and /runs/stream (skills/public/claude-to-deerflow/SKILL.md:8-89; README.md:1276-1303, install: npx skills add https://github.com/bytedance/deer-flow --skill claude-to-deerflow). DeerFlow -> Claude/Codex: (a) model providers that reuse CLI logins, ClaudeChatModel (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN / ~/.claude/.credentials.json) and CodexChatModel (~/.codex/auth.json) (README.md:213-233); (b) the invoke_acp_agent tool spawning ACP adapters such as @zed-industries/claude-agent-acp, @zed-industries/codex-acp or mcode as host subprocesses (config.example.yaml:1815-1850; backend/packages/harness/deerflow/tools/builtins/invoke_acp_agent_tool.py:232-245). No use of the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or a Codex SDK was found (repo-wide grep).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No analytics, telemetry or update-check SDK was found in first-party backend, frontend or scripts (grep for common analytics SDKs returned nothing); telemetry of third-party dependencies such as langgraph-cli cannot be verified from this checkout. Tracing is opt-in and off by default: LangSmith (LANGSMITH_TRACING), Langfuse (LANGFUSE_TRACING), Monocle (MONOCLE_TRACING; default exporter 'file', remote okahu/s3/blob/gcs exporters send prompts, tool args and responses off-box) - backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/tracing_config.py:143-170; README.md:847-905. The frontend calls api.github.com (star counter) only when GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN is set (frontend/src/app/github-stars/route.ts:13-19). Every Gateway response carries a local X-Trace-Id correlation header (README.md:795-798). Required network/accounts: an endpoint and credential for at least one LLM provider (README.md:258-263; .env.example); DeerFlow itself needs no vendor account. Gateway users are DeerFlow-local: the first admin is created through the public /api/v1/auth/initialize route (backend/app/gateway/auth_middleware.py:53-54; README.md:1886-1888) and auth can be bypassed with DEER_FLOW_AUTH_DISABLED=1 (backend/app/gateway/auth_disabled.py:11,30-45). Default tools call third parties: web_search = DuckDuckGo via ddgs (no key) and web_fetch = hosted Jina Reader at https://r.jina.ai/ (config.example.yaml:801-806,1058-1062; backend/packages/harness/deerflow/community/jina_ai/jina_client.py:30), so fetched URLs go to Jina; other providers (Tavily, Exa, Brave, Serper, Firecrawl, InfoQuest/BytePlus, ...) need their own keys (config.example.yaml:748-1130; README.md:36-42). Sandboxes: the default AIO image is pulled from enterprise-public-cn-beijing.cr.volces.com (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/community/aio_sandbox/aio_sandbox_provider.py:69), the network-policy sidecar from ghcr.io/bytedance/deer-flow-sandbox-network-proxy:latest (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/sandbox_config.py:33-37), E2B needs an E2B_API_KEY and cloud VMs (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/community/e2b_sandbox/e2b_sandbox_provider.py:374-376; .env.example:49-51), and the Codex provider posts to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/models/openai_codex_provider.py:29,271). Build/install-time fetches: PyPI/npm registries, the nodesource apt key and @larksuite/cli in backend/Dockerfile:36-45; the Lark skill pack is downloaded from GitHub at install time (README.md:1018-1021). Ports: non-Docker launchers bind the Gateway on 0.0.0.0:8001 and nginx on all interfaces :2026 (scripts/serve.sh:498; docker/nginx/nginx.local.conf:55-56; backend/app/gateway/config.py:9-10), whereas the Docker stack publishes only nginx on ${BIND_HOST:-127.0.0.1}:2026 (docker/docker-compose.yaml:53-54) and bundles a Redis container (docker-compose.yaml:29-42).

entry_points.what: FastAPI Gateway ASGI app (uvicorn app.gateway.app:app, port 8001): REST plus LangGraph-compatible threads/runs/SSE API with the agent runtime embedded in the same process; started by backend/Makefile:10,20, scripts/serve.sh:498 and the Dockerfile CMD.
`deerflow` console script (harness pyproject [project.scripts]): TUI, --print, --json, --continue, --resume, --recursion-limit, and `deerflow extensions ...`.
DeerFlowClient embedded Python client: chat()/stream(), threads, goals, skills, MCP config, uploads, memory.

create_deerflow_agent(model: BaseChatModel, tools, features, checkpointer, subagent_runtime) config-free SDK factory; make_lead_agent (agents/__init__.py) is the graph registered in backend/langgraph.json for langgraph dev/Studio.
Root orchestration (setup, doctor, check, install, dev, start, up, down, docker-*), delegating to scripts/serve.sh, scripts/deploy.sh and scripts/docker.sh.
Optional sandbox provisioner service (port 8002) that creates one Kubernetes Pod plus Service per sandbox_id for AioSandboxProvider provisioner mode.
Next.js workspace UI (pnpm 10.26.2; dev/build/start scripts, rstest unit tests, Playwright e2e); served behind nginx on :2026.
Helm chart (gateway, frontend, nginx, provisioner, optional Postgres/Redis) published to GHCR as an OCI artifact on v* tags.

code.architecture: Monorepo. Backend (Python 3.12, uv workspace): backend/packages/harness/deerflow (publishable deerflow-harness, import deerflow.*, 565 .py files) holds the agent framework: agents/lead_agent (agent.py factory; prompt.py system prompt including the citation rules), agents/middlewares (49 modules: sandbox/thread-data, summarization, loop detection, token budget, skill tool-policy, tool receipts, ...), agents/memory/backends (deermem default, mem0, honcho, openviking, noop), subagents (executor, registry, built-in general-purpose and bash agents, durable batch runtime, capacity), sandbox (Sandbox interface, LocalSandboxProvider, bash/ls/read_file/write_file/str_replace/glob/grep tools in sandbox/tools.py), community (sandbox providers aio_sandbox, e2b_sandbox, boxlite, tenki, opensandbox; search/fetch/browser/RAG tool providers), models (factory.py, patched providers, CLI-token providers), mcp, skills, tools/builtins (task, invoke_acp_agent, present_files, ask_clarification), runtime (runs/manager.py RunManager with leases and orphan recovery, runs/worker.py, checkpointer, event stores, stream bridge, goal), persistence (SQLAlchemy + Alembic), config (pydantic sections for config.yaml), tracing, tui, client.py. backend/app (import app.*, 119 .py files) is the FastAPI Gateway (gateway/app.py, routers/, auth with local users/JWT/PAT/OIDC, CSRF, authz) and IM channels (channels/: Feishu, Slack, Telegram, Discord, DingTalk, WeChat, WeCom, Buzz, GitHub). backend/packages/extension-api is the dependency-free public extension contract. Runtime topology: nginx :2026 -> Gateway :8001 (LangGraph agent graph, sub-agent thread pools and run state live in the Gateway process; tool calls go to the configured sandbox) plus Next.js frontend :3000 (492 TS/TSX files), optional provisioner :8002 (Kubernetes sandbox pods) and Redis in the Docker stack. Skills are Markdown packages under skills/public (23) with optional scripts, loaded progressively; configuration lives in config.yaml and extensions_config.json.
code.packaging_and_release: Tag-driven (v*) releases (RELEASING.md:3-8): .github/workflows/verify-versions.yml gates on backend/pyproject.toml, frontend/package.json and Chart.yaml matching the tag (scripts/verify_versions.sh). container.yaml builds and pushes ghcr.io/<owner>/deer-flow-{backend,frontend,provisioner} (tags: git tag, branch, sha, latest on the default branch; backend built with UV_EXTRAS=postgres, container.yaml:40-44,58-59) and adds GitHub build-provenance attestations via actions/attest-build-provenance (container.yaml:61-66,109-114,157-162); release images are amd64-only (nightly.yaml:10). chart.yaml lints/renders and then helm-pushes the chart to oci://ghcr.io/<owner>/charts with no attestation or signature step (chart.yaml:76-100). nightly.yaml publishes :nightly images and a nightly chart daily at 16:00 UTC (nightly.yaml:26-29). lark-cli-images.yaml and sandbox-network-proxy-image.yaml publish multi-arch (amd64+arm64) sandbox helper images with attestations; the proxy image is pushed as :latest and :sha-<sha> on every main push touching it (sandbox-network-proxy-image.yaml:62-78). No cosign, SBOM, checksum or GPG steps and no GitHub-Release, PyPI or npm publishing workflow exist under .github (grep); RELEASING.md:189-193 only suggests drafting a GitHub Release by hand. Publishing workflows pin actions by commit SHA (container.yaml:28-47). CHANGELOG dates: 2.1.0 on 2026-09-24, 2.0.0 on 2026-06-15 (CHANGELOG.md:8,3080).
code.tests_and_ci: Backend: pytest (+pytest-asyncio, hypothesis, blockbuster for blocking-IO gates, pytest-split) with 738 test_*.py files under backend/tests (690 top-level, 47 in tests/blocking_io, 1 in tests/monocle); `make test` excludes live and blocking_io tests; `make test-live` (real DeerFlowClient/LLM calls, API cost) is manual (backend/Makefile:22-29,42-45; README.md:1903-1908). Frontend: rstest unit tests (202 *.test.ts(x) files under frontend/tests/unit) and Playwright e2e (52 *.spec.ts under frontend/tests/e2e*); root tests/skills has 4 test files. 16 workflow files in .github/workflows, all on ubuntu-latest only (no macOS/Windows matrix) and using no secret other than GITHUB_TOKEN (so no live-LLM job): backend-unit-tests.yml (4-way duration-sharded pytest with Postgres 17 and Redis 7 services plus a default-install collection job), backend-blocking-io-tests.yml, frontend-unit-tests.yml, e2e-tests.yml (Playwright against a mocked API), replay-e2e.yml (record/replay backend golden SSE test plus full-stack render, no API keys), lint-check.yml (ruff, uv.lock check, eslint/prettier/tsc, next build, AGENTS.md guidance check), sandbox-image-smoke.yml (live real-image Docker sandbox hardening smoke on PRs touching aio_sandbox), skill-review-ci.yml, chart.yaml (helm lint/template on PRs), triage.yml and label-sync.yml (labels), plus publishing/gating workflows (container, chart, nightly, lark-cli-images, sandbox-network-proxy-image, verify-versions).
code.dependencies: backend/pyproject.toml (app + Gateway): 19 direct runtime deps (deerflow-harness, deerflow-extension-api, fastapi, httpx, starlette<2, uvicorn[standard], lark-oapi, slack-sdk, python-telegram-bot, e2b-code-interpreter, bcrypt, pyjwt, ...), 8 optional extras (postgres, redis, discord, buzz, monocle, ollama, browser, memory-zh), 11 dev-group deps. backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml (deerflow-harness 2.1.0): 41 direct runtime deps (langchain>=1.3, langgraph>=1.2.9,<1.3, langgraph-api, langgraph-cli, langgraph-runtime-inmem, langchain-openai/anthropic/google-genai/deepseek, langchain-mcp-adapters, agent-client-protocol, agent-sandbox, kubernetes, e2b-code-interpreter, sqlalchemy+alembic+aiosqlite, duckdb, markitdown[all,xlsx], tavily/firecrawl/exa/ddgs, cryptography, ...) and 12 optional extras (tui, groundroute, ollama, postgres, redis, pymupdf, boxlite, tenki, opensandbox, monocle, browser, memory-zh). backend/packages/extension-api/pyproject.toml: 0 deps. examples/deerflow-extension-example/pyproject.toml: 4 deps (+3 dev). frontend/package.json: 81 dependencies + 22 devDependencies (next ^16.3.3, react ^19, @langchain/langgraph-sdk, ...; pnpm 10.26.2). Lockfiles: backend/uv.lock (250 locked packages; uv 0.11.1 pinned in CI and Docker) and frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml. Python >=3.12 (backend/.python-version), Node 22 (frontend/Dockerfile:10).
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md (root): says there is no official release yet, only the latest version gets security updates (2.x on main, 1.x on main-1.x), and directs reporters to https://github.com/bytedance/deer-flow/security; no contact email, response SLA or disclosure timeline (SECURITY.md:1-13). Threat-model guidance lives in README.md:1860-1897 and backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:1127-1205 instead.

claim_checks.claim: AioSandboxProvider runs shell in isolated containers; LocalSandboxProvider host bash is disabled by default (README.md:1477)
claim_checks.evidence: allow_host_bash defaults False (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/sandbox_config.py:178-181); the bash tool is filtered out unless allowed (deerflow/tools/tools.py:109-111; deerflow/sandbox/security.py:35-45). Docker AIO containers get --cap-drop=ALL plus 5 compat caps, no-new-privileges and 2g / 2 CPU / 512 PID limits (deerflow/community/aio_sandbox/local_backend.py:1700-1758, 231-233). Caveats from code/docs: seccomp=unconfined by default (local_backend.py:1743-1744), default egress open (sandbox_config.py:15-18), unauthenticated sandbox HTTP API (backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:904), and the make setup wizard defaults to the Local provider (scripts/wizard/steps/execution.py:26-30).

claim_checks.claim: sandbox.network.mode isolated/allowlist restricts Docker AIO egress (README.md:1479-1488)
claim_checks.evidence: Default mode is 'open' (sandbox_config.py:15-18); restricted modes create a per-sandbox --internal bridge plus a proxy sidecar (aio_sandbox/local_backend.py:1050-1111; aio_sandbox/network_proxy.py), require Docker Engine 28+ and fail closed otherwise (local_backend.py:790-803); unavailable for provisioner mode and Apple Container (backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:878-880,922); proxy_image defaults to the mutable ghcr.io/bytedance/deer-flow-sandbox-network-proxy:latest (sandbox_config.py:33-37).

True for the Docker stack: nginx is published on ${BIND_HOST:-127.0.0.1}:${PORT:-2026} (docker/docker-compose.yaml:53-54). Not true for the non-Docker launchers: scripts/serve.sh:498 starts the Gateway with --host 0.0.0.0 (also backend/app/gateway/config.py:9 and backend/Makefile:10,20) and docker/nginx/nginx.local.conf:55-56 listens on 2026 and [::]:2026 without an address. AGENTS.md:40-48 describes those binds as container-internal.

claim_checks.claim: ACP agents (Codex/Claude Code adapters, mcode) run through invoke_acp_agent in a per-thread workspace, with permission requests denied unless auto_approve_permissions (README.md:234-251)
claim_checks.evidence: Config default auto_approve_permissions=False and timeout 1800 s (deerflow/config/acp_config.py:19-37); permission requests are cancelled unless auto-approve (deerflow/tools/builtins/invoke_acp_agent_tool.py:98-125). Beyond the README: every call spawns a fresh host subprocess via spawn_agent_process with cwd set to the per-thread acp-workspace and a new ACP session (invoke_acp_agent_tool.py:21-51,232-245), so it runs on the Gateway host/container, not inside the AIO sandbox, keeps no session across calls, and returns only concatenated agent_message_chunk text (:187-204,265-268). The tool exists only when acp_agents is configured (deerflow/tools/tools.py:188-201).

claim_checks.claim: database.backend sqlite/postgres backs checkpointer/Store/app data and lease reconciliation marks dead-worker runs as errors (README.md:345-348, 361)
claim_checks.evidence: config.yaml loads default to backend sqlite at .deer-flow/data (deerflow/config/app_config.py:64-67,508-517) although the bare DatabaseConfig default is memory (config/database_config.py:143-146); get_checkpointer falls back to InMemorySaver when nothing persistent is selected (deerflow/runtime/checkpointer/provider.py:196-201). run_events.backend defaults to memory (config/run_events_config.py:22-25). Orphaned in-flight runs are recovered as errors ('Gateway restarted before this run reached a durable final state.' / 'Run lease expired') (deerflow/runtime/runs/manager.py:39-41,1861-1945); docs/task-continuity.md:99-103 states a stopped run is not resumed automatically, so resumption means a new run on the same thread_id/checkpoint.

claim_checks.claim: Model-agnostic: works with any OpenAI-compatible LLM; CLI-backed providers reuse Codex/Claude Code logins (README.md:1632, 213-233)
claim_checks.evidence: Models are arbitrary LangChain classes resolved by class path (deerflow/models/factory.py:208; config/model_config.py:21-26 extra=allow) with a free-string model id; the wizard ships OpenAI, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama and others (scripts/wizard/providers.py:219-300). CodexChatModel POSTs to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses with ~/.codex/auth.json tokens and an 'originator: codex_cli_rs' header (models/openai_codex_provider.py:29,238-244,271); ClaudeChatModel reuses Claude Code OAuth tokens plus a hardcoded Claude Code billing header (models/claude_provider.py:37-41,98-111). The repo contains no reference to GPT-6.x or 'Sol' (grep), wizard model lists are GPT-5/Claude-4.x-era (providers.py:224,258), and no OpenAI Agents SDK, Codex SDK or Claude Agent SDK is used (grep), so compatibility with a newer model or endpoint is not evidenced.

claim_checks.claim: Built-in skills cover research and DeerFlow produces cited research (README.md:964; skill tree README.md:1246-1253)
claim_checks.evidence: Research skills exist (skills/public/deep-research, github-deep-research, systematic-literature-review with an arXiv API script, academic-paper-review, consulting-analysis) but they are Markdown methodologies, not a code pipeline. The [citation:Title](URL) plus Sources convention is a system-prompt instruction (deerflow/agents/lead_agent/prompt.py:686-747); deep-research/SKILL.md has no citation rule; the UI only regex-extracts those links (frontend/src/core/citations/sources.ts:15-25); tool-receipt verification covers executed tool calls only: 'execution evidence only, does not validate claim correctness' (deerflow/agents/middlewares/receipt_verification.py:16,56). Nothing in code checks that a cited URL was fetched or supports the claim. The README example skill tree (research/, report-generation/, slide-creation/, web-page/) does not match skills/public (deep-research, ppt-generation, ...).

claim_checks.claim: DeerFlowClient gives in-process access with Gateway-identical schemas; multi-turn needs a checkpointer (README.md:1643, 1686)
claim_checks.evidence: deerflow/client.py:145-248 (sync chat()/stream() generators, threads, goals, skills, MCP, uploads); schema parity is tested by TestGatewayConformance (backend/tests/test_client.py:3540). Doc drift: the class docstring says calls are stateless without a checkpointer (client.py:151-154) but the code falls back to the configured checkpointer (client.py:471-477), i.e. sqlite for config.yaml deployments. subagent_enabled defaults to False (client.py:186). create_deerflow_agent(model: BaseChatModel, ...) is the config-free alternative (deerflow/agents/factory.py:66-81).

claim_checks.claim: claude-to-deerflow lets Claude Code drive a running DeerFlow (README.md:1276-1303)
claim_checks.evidence: skills/public/claude-to-deerflow/SKILL.md:8-89 documents curl calls to /api/langgraph/threads and /threads/{id}/runs/stream with recursion_limit 1000 and flash/standard/pro/ultra modes; chat.sh and status.sh ship alongside. The direction is Claude Code -> DeerFlow over HTTP only; it does not make DeerFlow a Claude Code worker.

claim_checks.claim: `uv pip install 'deerflow-harness[tui]'` installs the harness/TUI (README.md:1838; backend/docs/TUI.md:15)
claim_checks.evidence: backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml defines the package, the tui extra and the deerflow script (lines 61-67, 103-108), but no workflow in .github/workflows builds or publishes to PyPI (grep for pypi/twine/uv publish returned nothing) and the package index cannot be queried from this checkout.

benchmarks.what: Sub-agent context hand-off: complete isolated handoff vs opt-in parent-context snapshot; 8 synthetic JSON/Python tasks, 51 checks, one model (qwen3.8-flash-next), single historical run 2026-09-12; project-authored, committed as a metadata-only export not generated by the packaged runner
benchmarks.metric: mean parent+worker tokens; mean seconds; correct artifacts; normal completions; provider requests (isolated vs snapshot)
benchmarks.value: 13,196.1 vs 11,151.8 tokens (-15.5%); 33.73 s vs 20.14 s (-40.3%); correct artifacts 8/8 vs 8/8; normal completions 7/8 vs 7/8; requests 48 vs 42. The README itself says this is not evidence of general quality or production readiness.

benchmarks.what: DeerMem capacity-eviction policy (confidence-only vs hybrid-v1) at capacity 7: answers by deepseek-v4-flash over 40 LongMemEval-derived cases plus 5 synthetic correction cases; live run at revision 01f99d61 (2026-08-18)
benchmarks.metric: QA accuracy (exact McNemar p) and offline support retention (confidence vs hybrid-v1)
benchmarks.value: official 23/40 vs 35/40 (p=0.0018); synthetic 1/5 vs 5/5 (p=0.125); overall 24/45 vs 40/45 (p=0.0001); offline support retention 27/45 vs 45/45; confidence_control scenario 8/10 vs 7/10 (hybrid-v1 lower)

benchmarks.what: Task-continuity replay prototype after forced context compaction (arms A-D; A = default summarization baseline, C vs D = keyword vs dense retrieval over the same compacted history); described as a historical prototype, not the shipped implementation, and explicitly not a measure of general coding-agent reliability
benchmarks.metric: correct answers per arm on selected cases
benchmarks.value: public history QA (42 selected, 2 operational failures): A 9, B 11, C 36, D 34; controlled tasks (24): A 17, B 18, C 23, D 22; known-goal variants (12): A 11, B 12, C 11, D 9

risks: Model/SDK fit is not evidenced: the repo never mentions GPT-6.x or 'Sol'; OpenAI/Anthropic are reached through LangChain classes (langchain-openai>=1.2.1, langchain-anthropic>=1.4.1; backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml:24,28) or custom CLI-token providers, not the OpenAI Agents SDK, a Codex SDK or the Claude Agent SDK (grep); wizard model lists are GPT-5/Claude-4.x-era (scripts/wizard/providers.py:224,258) and the README recommends Doubao/DeepSeek/Kimi (README.md:32). The only published measurements cover memory, hand-off and compaction; none measures coding or research quality, and docs/experiments/task-continuity-20260912/README.md:61 disclaims general coding-agent reliability.

Vendor-CLI credential reuse depends on undocumented vendor behavior: CodexChatModel calls the chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex endpoint with Codex CLI OAuth tokens and 'originator: codex_cli_rs' (deerflow/models/openai_codex_provider.py:29,243,271); ClaudeChatModel presents Claude Code OAuth tokens with oauth/claude-code beta flags and a hardcoded Claude Code billing header (cc_version=2.1.85.351; cc_entrypoint=cli) that needs an env override if it drifts (models/claude_provider.py:37-41; models/credential_loader.py:27). Compose used to bind-mount whole ~/.claude and ~/.codex and now needs opt-in overlays (backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:1163-1194).

Isolation is opt-in and wraps a non-isolated agent loop: the agent loop, sub-agent thread pools and run state live in the Gateway process (README.md:361; backend/README.md:94) and only tool calls reach the sandbox. make setup defaults to LocalSandboxProvider (scripts/wizard/steps/execution.py:26-30), which README.md:1477 calls not a secure isolation boundary. AIO containers ship seccomp=unconfined, open egress and an unauthenticated sandbox HTTP API by default (aio_sandbox/local_backend.py:1743-1744; config/sandbox_config.py:15-18; backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:904), and the default image is the mutable :latest tag from a Volcengine registry that config.example.yaml:1481-1489 says is frozen on an old pre-1.9.3 digest; its Dockerfile is not in the repo (CONFIGURATION.md:964). The Kubernetes provisioner disables TLS verification when K8S_API_SERVER is set (docker/provisioner/app.py:384-390; docker/docker-compose.yaml:191).

Host exposure: make up / docker-start in AIO mode append the overlay that mounts the host /var/run/docker.sock into the Gateway container, which the project calls root-equivalent host control (scripts/deploy.sh:373-394; docker/docker-compose.dood.yaml:9-13; backend/docs/CONFIGURATION.md:1141-1148). Non-Docker launchers bind the Gateway on 0.0.0.0:8001 and nginx on all interfaces (scripts/serve.sh:498; docker/nginx/nginx.local.conf:55-56). Gateway admin equals host code execution via stdio MCP (README.md:1869-1877); auth can be disabled with DEER_FLOW_AUTH_DISABLED=1 (backend/app/gateway/auth_disabled.py:11,30-45); the first admin is created through a public /api/v1/auth/initialize route (backend/app/gateway/auth_middleware.py:53-54; README.md:1886-1888). Guardrails, authorization and the lead-agent token budget are off by default (config/guardrails_config.py:21; config/authorization_config.py:29; config/token_budget_config.py:9).

Resume/durability gaps: orphaned runs are failed, not resumed (deerflow/runtime/runs/manager.py:39-41,1944; docs/task-continuity.md:99-103); run_events default to in-memory (config/run_events_config.py:22-25); production defaults to one Gateway worker because run tasks are owned in-process and multi-worker needs Postgres+Redis+heartbeats (README.md:361; docker/docker-compose.yaml:107); browser tools require GATEWAY_WORKERS=1 (README.md:1525); headless `deerflow --print/--json` returns exit code 0 whenever the call returns, without mapping agent errors (deerflow/tui/cli.py:262-285); ACP-delegated workers are stateless per call (tools/builtins/invoke_acp_agent_tool.py:232-268). No built-in repo checkout/worktree feature was found: code tasks rely on uploads, global sandbox.mounts, or the agent running git itself (backend/app/gateway/github/prompts.py:161-166; config.example.yaml:1442-1451).

Research evidence is prompt-level: citations ([citation:Title](URL)) are requested by the system prompt (deerflow/agents/lead_agent/prompt.py:686-747) but no code verifies that sources were fetched or support the claims; receipt verification is advisory and only for executed tool calls (agents/middlewares/receipt_verification.py:16,56). Defaults send queries to DuckDuckGo and page URLs to the hosted Jina Reader (config.example.yaml:801-806,1058-1062; community/jina_ai/jina_client.py:30). The v1 research graph is not part of 2.x (README.md:17); skills that run scripts (github_api.py, arxiv_search.py) need an executing sandbox, and bash is hidden under the default Local provider (tools/tools.py:109-111; skills/public/github-deep-research/SKILL.md:39-45).

Maintenance churn and large surface: v2.1.0 (2026-09-24) closed 772 PRs and lists breaking changes to gateway headers, skills layout, E2B capacity semantics and the memory API/config shape (CHANGELOG.md:8-70); config_version is 45 (config.example.yaml:23); DB schemas move by forward Alembic revisions with an offline recovery procedure for mismatched stamps (README.md:1701-1704; docs/database-forward-revision-recovery.md) and the memory v1->v2 migration is one-way (README.md:1626). SECURITY.md supports only the latest version and says there is no official release yet (SECURITY.md:5-8). The codebase is 565 harness plus 119 app Python files and 492 frontend TS(X) files for a runtime that also bundles UI, auth, IM channels and scheduling.

Release and supply-chain evidence is thin and docs drift: images are amd64-only (.github/workflows/nightly.yaml:10); build-provenance attestations exist for images (container.yaml:61-66) but not the Helm chart (chart.yaml:76-100); no signatures, SBOM, checksums, GitHub-Release, PyPI or npm publishing workflow exist, although README.md:1838 tells users to `uv pip install 'deerflow-harness[tui]'`. Builds fetch the nodesource apt key and @larksuite/cli (backend/Dockerfile:36-45) and the network-proxy image is published as mutable :latest on each main push (sandbox-network-proxy-image.yaml:62-72). Docs drift: SECURITY.md is cited for DooD/CLI-credential guidance it does not contain (scripts/deploy.sh:368,393; .env.example:110), backend/README.md:93 says a 15-minute sub-agent timeout whereas built-ins default to 1800 s (config/subagents_config.py:142-146), and README.md:1246-1253 lists skills that do not exist.

checks.statement: Docker production install via `make up` (builds images and starts all production services), Linux recommended.
checks.note: README.md:330-337 shows `make up  # Build images and start all production services`, `make down` and access at http://localhost:2026. Makefile:214-215 maps `up` to scripts/deploy.sh. The script's default path is build + start: `docker compose ... up --build -d --remove-orphans --wait --wait-timeout 180` (deploy.sh:421-425). It checks for config.yaml first (deploy.sh:127-147). README.md:280 backs the 'Linux recommended' label.

checks.statement: License is MIT (SPDX MIT), declared in the root LICENSE file.
checks.note: LICENSE:1 reads 'MIT License', with copyright lines for Bytedance Ltd. (2025) and DeerFlow Authors (2025-2026) and the standard MIT grant. No license field in any pyproject.toml, package.json or Chart.yaml contradicts it. Caveat: skills/public/frontend-design/LICENSE.txt and skills/public/skill-creator/LICENSE.txt are Apache-2.0, so these two bundled skills have their own license. That does not contradict the project-level claim.

checks.statement: yes - Linux plus Docker is the recommended persistent-server target; CI and release builds run on ubuntu-latest; backend/frontend/provisioner images are amd64-only.
checks.note: README.md:280 matches verbatim. backend-unit-tests.yml:50 is `runs-on: ubuntu-latest`. The release jobs in container.yaml (lines 17, 70, 118) also run on ubuntu-latest, which the cited CI line alone does not show. nightly.yaml:10 says 'Images are amd64-only to match the release builds.' container.yaml's build-push-action steps set no `platforms:` and there is no QEMU/buildx setup step, so the images are native amd64 only.

checks.statement: Claude Code -> DeerFlow via the claude-to-deerflow skill (curl against /api/langgraph/threads and /runs/stream; installed with npx skills add); DeerFlow -> Claude/Codex via CLI-login model providers (ClaudeChatModel, CodexChatModel) and invoke_acp_agent spawning ACP adapters (claude-agent-acp, codex-acp, mcode) as host subprocesses; no Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or Codex SDK used.
checks.note: In SKILL.md, line 8 says 'running DeerFlow instance via its HTTP API', line 28 sets the default base `${DEERFLOW_URL}/api/langgraph`, line 56 POSTs .../threads and line 66 POSTs .../threads/<id>/runs/stream. README.md:1283 has the npx command; README.md:232-233 list ~/.codex/auth.json and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN / ~/.claude/.credentials.json. config.example.yaml has the adapters at 1823 (mcode), 1833 (@zed-industries/claude-agent-acp) and 1845 (@zed-industries/codex-acp). invoke_acp_agent_tool.py:233-245 calls spawn_agent_process(client, cmd, *args, env, cwd=<per-thread workspace>) and then new_session. A repo-wide grep for claude-agent-sdk, claude_code_sdk, openai-agents, 'from agents import' and codex-sdk found nothing. Wording nuance: the subprocesses are children of the Gateway process, so in the Docker stack they run inside the Gateway container (README.md:251), not on the Docker host.

checks.statement: AioSandboxProvider runs shell in isolated containers; LocalSandboxProvider host bash is disabled by default (verified: yes, with hardening details and caveats).
checks.note: README.md:1477 matches. allow_host_bash defaults to False (sandbox_config.py:178-181). tools.py:109-111 drops host bash unless is_host_bash_allowed(), which returns allow_host_bash only for the Local provider (security.py:35-45). For the Docker runtime only (guard at local_backend.py:1685), lines 1714-1724 add --cap-drop=ALL plus CHOWN/FOWNER/SETUID/SETGID/DAC_OVERRIDE and no-new-privileges. Defaults of 2g / 2 CPUs / 512 PIDs (lines 231-233) are applied at 1753-1758. All caveats are confirmed: seccomp=unconfined by default (1743-1744); network mode defaults to 'open' (sandbox_config.py:15-18); CONFIGURATION.md:904 says the sandbox HTTP API 'has no authentication'; the wizard's execution-mode choice defaults to index 0, LocalSandboxProvider (execution.py:25-30).
